name: 800G passive copper DAC (NVIDIA MCP4Y10, OSFP twin-port 2x400G)
description: Passive direct-attach copper, 8 x 100G-PAM4 lanes, 0.5-2 m (30AWG to 1.5 m, 26AWG at 2 m), 16 twinax pairs. Switch-to-switch or in-rack links only.

power_per_end_w.note: max power consumption 0.1 W (EEPROM only); passive, effectively zero

weight_kg_per_m.note: not published. 16-pair 30AWG twinax, 7.2 mm OD (26AWG 8.9 mm) per NVIDIA spec; scaled from Credo 800G AEC weights (slope ~0.08 kg/m for a thinner cable) by cross-section
